mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE company_user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'DOCUMENT_PASSED', 'EVALUATING')) AS in_progress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE company_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SELECTED') AS selected, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement s INNER JOIN application a ON s.application_id = a.application_id WHERE a.company_user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'REJECTED') AS rejected_settlement
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation e INNER JOIN application a ON e.application_id = a.application_id WHERE e.evaluator_user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 'ASSIGNED' AND a.status = 'EVALUATING'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED') AS submitted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application a WHERE a.status = 'EVALUATING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e WHERE e.application_id = a.application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e WHERE e.application_id = a.application_id AND e.status <> 'COMPLETED')) AS ready_to_select, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement WHERE status = 'REQUESTED') AS settlement_requested

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE approval_status = 'REQUESTED') AS pending_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE locked_at > #{lockedSince}) AS locked_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_history WHERE result_code IN ('FAIL_PASSWORD', 'FAIL_UNKNOWN_ID', 'LOCKED') AND login_at >= #{todayStart}) AS login_failures_today
